data.one_liner: Determines whether the app is running within Firebase Test Lab on Android.
data.what_it_does: This plugin for Android detects if the application is executing within Firebase Test Lab during Google Play Pre-Launch Reports. It checks the system property firebase.test.lab and returns a boolean value or null on unsupported platforms.
use_when: You want to disable analytics or tracking during Firebase Test Lab runs.
You need to differentiate between regular user usage and automated pre-launch report tests.
avoid_when: Your app targets platforms other than Android where this plugin returns null.
You need features beyond detecting Firebase Test Lab environments.
strengths: Simple API with a single check method.
Prevents skewed analytics data from automated pre-launch reports.
weaknesses: Requires Flutter 3.47 and Android API 24 or newer.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter 3.47 or newer and Android API 24 or newer. Android builds require AGP 9 with built-in Kotlin support.
